column7: The #3684 self-replacement over PUT /api/v1/projects/{id}/members/{self} through a real router: a project-scoped roles.assign holder (a second one present) setting their own project role to one they could grant only through the role it removes. Before #3840 the answer was 503 MutationPartiallyApplied with retry_safe true and the actor's roles.assign role removed (red at cfb185753); now exactly 403 with the core ceiling text and nothing changed. The same replacement made by another admin still applies (TestRoleSetReplaceHTTP_OtherAdminReplacement_StillApplies). Transport retry_safe mapping: server/http/handlers TestSendPartialMutation_RetrySafeFollowsRetryRefused, server/grpc/services TestPartialMutationStatus_RetrySafeFollowsRetryRefused. gRPC has no role-set replacement RPC.
